gateway.title: Secure payment (simulation)
gateway.sessionWarning: One minute left in your payment session.
gateway.secureNote: Card details are entered only on your bank’s secure page — never on this website.
gateway.methodCard: Paying by card: Visa or Mastercard

bank.label: Bank
bank.title: Select your bank
bank.text: Choose the bank that issued your KNET card.

knetCard.label: Card details
knetCard.title: Card details
knetCard.text: On KNET’s page you enter your card number, expiry date and PIN. This demo never asks for them.

confirm.label: Confirm
confirm.title: Confirm your payment
confirm.text: Please review the details below, then confirm.

otp.label: SMS code
otp.title: Verification code
otp.text: {bank} has sent a six-digit code by SMS to the mobile number registered with your card.
otp.note: On the real page you would type this code. Here it is shown for the demo — there is nothing to enter.
otp.expired: This code has expired. Request a new one to continue.
otp.resent: A new code has been sent.

card.label: Card details
card.title: Pay by card
card.text: On your bank’s secure page you enter your card number, expiry date and security code. This demo never asks for them.

secure.label: Verification
secure.title: Verify it’s you
secure.text: Your bank confirms card payments with 3-D Secure — a one-time code or an approval in its app.
secure.request: Approve a payment of <price>{amount}</price> to <brand>Mystic Sand</brand>?
secure.note: In this demo nothing is sent to your phone — simply approve.

processing.title: Processing your payment
processing.text: Please keep this page open — this only takes a moment.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.hint: Choose how this simulated payment ends. KNET’s real page has no such controls.

success.title: Thank you, <bdi>{name}</bdi>
success.text: Your payment has been received, and your order is being prepared with care.

failed.title: Payment not completed
failed.declined: Your bank didn’t approve the payment.
failed.timeout: Your secure payment session timed out.
failed.awaiting: This order is still waiting for payment.
failed.reassurance: You have not been charged. Your bag and details are saved.
failed.helpText: Hello Mystic Sand, I need help paying for order {id}.

notFound.title: We can’t find this order on this device
notFound.text: Orders are saved in the browser they were placed from. WhatsApp us with the order number and we’ll look it up for you.
notFound.textNoId: WhatsApp us and we’ll help you find your order.
notFound.whatsappText: Hello Mystic Sand, I’m asking about order {id}.
notFound.whatsappTextNoId: Hello Mystic Sand, I need help with an order.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.footer: Thank you for choosing Mystic Sand. Unopened items may be returned within {days, plural, one {{daysText} day} other {{daysText} days}}.
